annotations.title: Change job reference and Xero settings

description: Change how job references are read and how bills are entered in Xero.

payment_terms_days.description: Days after month end the bill is due. Default 30.

price_alert_percent.description: Smallest price change worth flagging. Default 1.

xero_account_code.description: Xero account the bills go to. Default 300 (Purchases); falls back to cost of sales if missing.

xero_tracking_category.description: Name of a Xero tracking category (for example Job) to tag each line with its job. Off by default.

name: update_settings
